result.description: Compact fictional plug-and-play audio module designed for standalone virtual-reality rigs and immersive demo stations. Features spatial sound processing, low-latency USB-C connectivity, and onboard 48GB cache for locally stored scene packs and calibration profiles. Intended for desktop and arcade-style simulation use, not general-purpose storage.
result.title: Aster Vale 48GB VR Audio Module
result.title_description: VR audio module with local cache and spatial processing
